description: Verkeersongevallen - Bestand geRegistreerde Ongevallen Nederland is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Het bestand geRegistreerde Ongevallen Nederland is een bestand met de ongevallenmeldingen van diverse aanleverende instanties gekoppeld aan het digitale wegennet (het Nationale Wegenbestand, NWB). Met dit product kunt u verschillende verkeersveiligheidsanalyses voor uw beheersgebied uitvoeren en is in het bijzonder geschikt voor: - beleid (formuleren, monitoren, evalueren), - onderzoek en - wegbeheer. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are bron, ongevallen, verkeer, verkeersongevallen. It offers 27 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
